description: Save the posting times the queue uses, replacing the ones saved before: either the same times on some days (times and days), or each day’s own (week). To change one day, read queue_get, change that day in week and send the whole week back. Ask the user which days and times they want first. Posts that are already scheduled keep their times, and saved pacing rules (queue_rules_get) stay untouched.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: With times: the days to post on, from mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun. Every day when left out.

times.description: The short way, for the same times on several days: one to twelve times of day on the 24-hour clock with two digits each, such as "09:00" or "17:30". They are read in the workspace time zone. Leave out when sending week.

week.description: Each day’s own times, for days that differ, such as { "mon": ["17:30"], "tue": ["09:00", "17:30"] }. A day left out has none. Send this or times and days, not both.

name: queue_set
title: Set the posting times
